description: Run the PaperTrail unit tests whenever a Python file is saved, so a broken change is caught immediately. This is a Kiro agent hook configuration, documented here; the hook runs in the Kiro IDE, where hooks are configured, and the same command can be run by hand: python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
name: test-on-save
on_failure: report the failing test name and stop; do not commit a failing tree
